hero.purpose: The one largest line of a page: the home fold, the hub's series names, the landing headline, the ranks title, a fruit's or an ability's name.

display.purpose: The hub's headline, the legal page's title, the saga's name on the fruits page, a character's name.

headline.purpose: A listing's title and section headings.

title.purpose: Questions, group names and names in rows.

body.purpose: Running text, at a measure of 52 to 66ch.

lede.purpose: The sentence under a page's title.

label.purpose: The uppercase tracked word above or beside a value.

numeral.purpose: Episode and chapter numbers and the reader's point, in tabular figures.

micro.purpose: The kind inside a filler countdown cell on a phone, and the names of seas on the places map.

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: A state change on a control: hover, press, pick.

motion.name: dur-short
motion.purpose: The crossfade between two pages, and a dialog surfacing.

motion.name: dur-long
motion.purpose: A band settling, a sheet rising, the fog clearing, a drawing travelling between a list and its page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entering elements and state changes: they decelerate.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Defined for leaving elements; no code uses it today.

motion.name: settle-step
motion.purpose: The delay between one band of a page settling and the next (src/styles/settle.ts).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The cap on every animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion (src/styles/global.css).

breakpoints.name: seriesCramped
breakpoints.purpose: Below it (max-width: 11.99rem, large text on a phone) a series page's site bar sets the bookmark and the language one over the other, under the wordmark's own row, and pins at 11.5rem (BAR.fourRows; the query is BAR.seriesCramped).

breakpoints.name: siteCrowded
breakpoints.purpose: Below it (max-width: 12.99rem) the site's own bar (the hub and the legal page) sets the wordmark on a row of its own, the language under it, and pins at 6rem (BAR.twoRows; the query is BAR.siteCrowded).

breakpoints.name: seriesCrowded
breakpoints.purpose: Below it (max-width: 19.99rem, from 12rem) a series page's site bar sets the wordmark on a row of its own, then the bookmark and the language, then the series' row, and pins at 8.75rem (BAR.threeRows; the query is BAR.seriesCrowded). At the default text size it is below every phone; at 125% and up it is where a phone's bar no longer fits the wordmark beside the widest bookmark.

breakpoints.name: 22rem
breakpoints.purpose: A fruit or ability plate sets its name beside its label; below it, under the label.

breakpoints.name: 30rem
breakpoints.purpose: A character's facts set label and value side by side.

breakpoints.name: 32rem (min-height)
breakpoints.purpose: With min-width: 40rem, the window in which a listing's control bar pins whole and a places index's group heads pin under it; in a shorter or narrower one the bar folds to one row that names the places group in view, and those heads scroll (CONTROLS.whole in tokens.stylex.ts).

breakpoints.name: 37.5rem
breakpoints.purpose: Up to it the places map is drawn upright; from it the fruit album has three columns, and a folded group of fog tiles keeps three instead of two.

breakpoints.name: 40rem
breakpoints.purpose: The line between phone and wider. Below it (max-width: 39.99rem) dialogs and peeks are bottom sheets, and the fruits page folds each group of fog tiles to its first row. From it grids, type sizes and spacing across the site take their wider steps, and the site bar's gaps widen. No bar height depends on it: the bar's height changes at 56rem (seriesWide).

breakpoints.name: 48rem
breakpoints.purpose: The hub and the legal page's list of parts take their wide layout.

breakpoints.name: 50rem
breakpoints.purpose: The fruit album has four columns.

breakpoints.name: seriesWide
breakpoints.purpose: A series page's site bar sets its two rows on one and pins at 3.25rem (BAR.seriesWide).

breakpoints.name: 60rem
breakpoints.purpose: A record's page is two columns; the character grid and the home's cast gain columns.

breakpoints.name: 64rem
breakpoints.purpose: The control bar sets its groups beside the search; the fruit album has five columns and the landing preview six.

breakpoints.name: 76rem
breakpoints.purpose: The character grid has its last column. Also the width of the shell.

breakpoints.name: 80rem
breakpoints.purpose: The fruit album has six columns.

narrative.northStar: The spoiler boundary is a horizon you move
narrative.overview:
The reader's bookmark is one line through the story. What lies before it is drawn, named and lit; what lies after it is under fog. The site is dark, and only dark. Four colour sets share one structure: "Blackout" for the hub and the legal page, and one theme per series. Type, spacing, radii and motion are shared. The pictures are line drawings made for this project.

The owner prefers bold, dramatic, eye-catching UI with one central idea over restrained layouts. This identity is fixed (owner, 2026-11-17). Later passes refine hierarchy, spacing, states, motion, copy, responsive behaviour and accessibility, and add no font, colour or theme.

The code is the reference for how a component looks. This file holds the tokens, the rules and the open points.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, with one accent per colour set.
One central idea per page (owner); headings in Bricolage Grotesque at 800.
Uppercase tracked labels and mono numerals beside sentence-case headings.
Small radii, hairline rules, no drop shadows, line drawings.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One accent per series, never a large fill (owner, 2026-11-17). The accent is a line, a word, a border or a dot. The code fills a few surfaces with it, and they are the accepted set: the button of a primary action (Save in the bookmark dialog, owner 2026-10-12, and the landing page's primary buttons); the marks for filler in `FillerCountdown.styles.ts` and `FillerStrip.tsx`; and small marks such as a picked chip's dot. Text on a filled accent surface is Accent Ink. Keep these filled, and add no other. The hub's series cards and the home's drawing sit on plain paper, with no glow behind them (owner, 2026-11-23, #1378).

rules.name: The Floors Rule
rules.body: On every paper of every set, Ink and Ink 2 hold 7:1, Muted and the accent 4.5:1, Rule 2 and Focus 3:1, and Accent Ink on the accent 4.5:1. `src/styles/themes.test.tsx` computes them; a colour that changes keeps them.

rules.name: The Two Plus One Rule
rules.body: Two families and one outlier, and never a fourth.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the voice of data: numerals, counts and short uppercase labels (owner, 2026-11-17). It is never used for a sentence or a heading. The code uses it in 50 style lines in 29 files, and those uses stand. Two sentences were set in mono, the trial strip's line and the map's hint; they are in the body face since #1375 and #1380, and so are the map's zoom buttons.

dos: **Do** write every colour in OKLCH and take it from the tokens.
**Do** keep Instrument Sans as the body face. Impeccable lists it as overused; here it is fixed (owner, 2026-11-17).
**Do** keep the uppercase tracked label above or beside a heading. Impeccable bans a kicker above a heading; here it is part of the style (owner, 2026-11-17).

**Do** set numerals, counts and short uppercase labels in JetBrains Mono, and nothing longer: never a sentence or a heading. Impeccable treats mono outside code as a costume; here it is the voice of data by design (owner, 2026-11-17).
**Do** mark a link inside text with an underline. The accent sits within 3:1 of the inks in every set, so colour alone cannot.
**Do** space siblings with `gap` in new work; see Layout for today's state.
**Do** keep controls at least 44px tall. Under it today, for the surface passes (#1375 to #1383) to fix: relationship rows.

**Do** keep running text to a measure of 52 to 66ch. In Instrument Sans a line holds about 1.4 characters per `ch`, so the 60 to 75 characters a line the impeccable skill asks for is about 44 to 54ch. The legal page sets 48ch, about 67 characters (#1383), and the footer 52ch (#1377).
**Do** check every pass at a width of 390px. Mobile is the owner's second priority, after the bookmark and progress and before fog.
donts: **Don't** use `#000`, `#fff` or a grey with no hue.
**Don't** add a font, a colour, a theme or a light scheme.
**Don't** paint a large surface in the accent, or fill any surface with it beyond the set in the One Accent Rule.
**Don't** use a drawing tint as the colour of a control or of running text.
**Don't** use a radius above `rounded.card` on a rectangle, or a drop shadow.
**Don't** animate a `filter` or a layout property.
**Don't** show, name or hint at anything past the reader's bookmark. `PRODUCT.md` lists what is public by design, and `docs/architecture.md#spoiler-contract` is the authority.
**Don't** spread the legal notices: they live on the legal page, and the footer carries one line of notice and one link to the legal page.
**Don't** put design vocabulary (horizon, Blackout, Sea Chart) in the copy; it follows the `tone-of-voice` skill.
